You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered facts given.
Each fact is one line: subject | relation | value | condition (after "if:", when there is one) | the place it
comes from. A long value or condition is shortened and ends with "…"; a normal form (a date, a duration, a short
name) follows the value in brackets when there is one. Some facts carry a note computed from the dates: trust the notes.

Rules:
- Use only these facts. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the facts do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- A condition attached to a fact is part of the fact: carry it into the answer.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with every date in the facts, one by one, before you answer.
  A repeal, a limit or an application "from" a date takes effect on that date, not earlier: an act repealed from a
  date is still fully in force, with everything it permits, on every earlier day; a rule applying from a date does
  not yet bind on earlier days.
- If a note says that a date quoted in a condition was corrected, reason with the corrected date.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several facts answer it, list every one of them, in the words of the
  facts, one item per fact. Facts filed under the same article, annex part or numbered point belong together.
  When the answer is a group named by an article or an annex part and the facts list the members of that group,
  give the members, not the name of the group.
- A fact noted as "filed under a place the question names" belongs to the answer of a "which / what" question
  about that place whenever its relation fits the question: list all of them, not one.
- Lines under "Computed by rule" are results worked out in code from the numbered facts they name: trust them,
  give their result as the answer for the device asked about, and put the fact numbers they name in "used".
- Include only what the question asks for: no neighbouring item, no other regime that the question did not ask
  about. An option that combines several things in sequence is one item, not several.
- A fact about a neighbouring subject (another paragraph, another device, another kind of verification, another
  product, another deadline) does not answer the question. When the exact subject asked about is absent from the
  facts, "unknown" is the correct answer: do not answer from the nearest fact.
- For a "who" question, when one fact, or several facts with the same subject and relation, name several bodies,
  all of them are the answer together: name each one.
- For "which categories / which items listed in a place", the answer is the members filed under that place, each
  in the words of its fact, without adding the place to the item.
- For "which risks / which hazards does a numbered point address", use every fact filed under that point whatever
  its relation: a measure is required against a risk, and its subject and condition name that risk.
- Never return a list for a "text" answer: a question that one sentence answers (who, why, how, under which
  condition, which one thing and why) gets one short sentence. "Which / what / list all" of several things is "set".
- Facts marked "matched by relation" were found by querying the facts by their relation, subject and place:
  prefer them. When the question asks for all of something, the answer is the list of their subjects or values,
  one item per fact, nothing merged and nothing dropped. If the matched facts answer the question, do not add
  items from the other facts, which are context.
- The kind follows the question: "from which date / when (a day)" is "date"; "for how long" alone is "duration";
  "can / may / is / does" is "boolean"; "which / what (several things)" is "set"; who, why, under which condition,
  or who does something and within what time is "text", and the text names every element asked for.
- Return JSON only, with the reasoning first:
  {"reasoning": "the facts and dates compared, step by step, in a few short sentences",
   "kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [fact numbers you relied on]}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: Following a substantial modification of machinery, which party is regarded as its manufacturer?

Facts:
[0] non-professional user modifying machinery for own use | becomes manufacturer | shall not be considered to be a manufacturer | if: for his or her own use | [REG, Art. 18] [matched by relation]
[1] manufacturer | becomes manufacturer | puts those products into service for its own use | if: manufactures products within the scope of this Regulation | [REG, Art. 3(18)] [matched by relation]
[2] manufacturer | becomes manufacturer | markets those products under its name or trademark | if: manufactures products within the scope of this Regulation or who has those products designed or manufactured | [REG, Art. 3(18)] [matched by relation]
[3] importer or distributor | has obligation | subject to the obligations of the manufacturer set out in Articles 10… ("") | if: where that importer or distributor places a product within the scope of this Regulation on the market under its name or trademark or modifies… | [REG, Art. 17]
[4] importer or distributor | becomes manufacturer | where that importer or distributor places a product within the scope of… ("") | if: where that importer or distributor places a product within the scope of this Regulation on the market under its name or trademark or modifies… | [REG, Art. 17]
[5] person who carries out substantial modification | has obligation | ensure and declare on its sole responsibility | [REG, Art. 18]
[6] manufacturer | defined as | means any natural or legal person who designs and/or manufactures machinery | if: under his own name or trademark or for his own use | [DIR, Art. 2]
[7] natural or legal person carrying out substantial modification | has obligation | shall be subject to the obligations of the manufacturer set out in… | if: if the substantial modification has an impact on the safety of only machinery or a related product that is part of an assembly of… | [REG, Art. 18]
[8] substantial modification | defined as | a modification of machinery or a related product | if: which is not foreseen or planned by the manufacturer | [REG, Art. 3(16)]
[9] manufacturers | has obligation | draw up the technical documentation set out in Annex IV, Part A | if: Before placing machinery or a related product on the market or putting it into service | [REG, Art. 10(2)]
[10] manufacturers | has obligation | carry out the relevant conformity assessment procedure referred to in Article 25… | if: Before placing machinery or a related product on the market or putting it into service | [REG, Art. 10(2)]
[11] UR5e robot arm (Universal Robots e-Series) – whether it may be put into service on its own as delivered by the manufacturer | put into service only when | shall only be put into service upon being integrated into a final… | if: which conforms with the provisions of the Machinery Directive and other applicable Directives | [ur5e-manual, p. 220]
[12] UR5e robot arm (ur5e-manual, p. 180) – whether it can be put into service on its own as delivered by the manufacturer | is partly completed machinery | The robot is partly completed machinery (true) | [ur5e-manual, p. 180]
[13] non-professional user modifying machinery for own use | has obligation | shall not be subject to the obligations on the manufacturer set out… | if: for his or her own use | [REG, Art. 18]
[14] manufacturer | has obligation | shall apply one of the following procedures | if: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A | [REG, Art. 25(2)]
[15] manufacturer or his authorised representative | has obligation | shall apply one of the following procedures | if: Where the machinery is referred to in Annex IV and manufactured in accordance with the harmonised standards referred to in Article 7(2)… | [DIR, Art. 12(3)]
[16] manufacturer or his authorised representative | has obligation | shall apply one of the following procedures | if: Where the machinery is referred to in Annex IV and has not been manufactured in accordance with the harmonised standards referred to in Article… | [DIR, Art. 12(4)]
[17] manufacturers | has obligation | shall ensure that it has been designed and constructed | if: When placing machinery or a related product on the market or putting it into service | [REG, Art. 10(1)]
[18] copy of EU type-examination certificate, annexes, additions and technical documentation kept by manufacturer | retention period | for at least 10 years (P10Y) | if: after the machinery or related product has been placed on the market or put into service | [REG, Annex VII, 7]
[19] manufacturer or authorised representative | has obligation | ensure that it satisfies the relevant essential health and safety requirements | if: Before placing machinery on the market and/or putting it into service | [DIR, Art. 5(1)]
[20] manufacturer or authorised representative | has obligation | ensure that the technical file referred to in Annex VII… | if: Before placing machinery on the market and/or putting it into service | [DIR, Art. 5(1)]
[21] manufacturer or authorised representative | has obligation | must ensure | if: When lifting machinery or lifting accessories are placed on the market or are first put into service | [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.3]
[22] manufacturers of partly completed machinery | has obligation | shall draw up the technical documentation set out in Annex IV… | if: Before placing partly completed machinery on the market | [REG, Art. 11(2)]
[23] manufacturer | has obligation | provide the assembly instructions in paper format free of charge within one… | if: at the request of the person who incorporates the partly completed machinery at the time of purchase | [REG, Art. 11(7)]
[24] importer | has obligation | shall inform the manufacturer and the market surveillance authorities | if: where the machinery or related product presents a risk to the health and safety of persons | [REG, Art. 13(2)]
[25] distributor | has obligation | shall inform the manufacturer or the importer as well as the market… | if: where the machinery or related product presents a risk to the health and safety of persons | [REG, Art. 15(3)]
[26] operating entity | has obligation | Carry out the checks specified in the test plan | [nanoscan3-manual, p. 106]
[27] relevant economic operator | has obligation | to put an end to the non-compliance concerned | if: where a Member State makes one of the following findings with regard to machinery or a related product | [REG, Art. 46(1)]
[28] relevant economic operator | has obligation | put an end to the non-compliance concerned | if: Without prejudice to Article 43, where a Member State makes one of the following findings with regard to partly completed machinery | [REG, Art. 46(2)]
[29] machinery or related product emergency stop | requires measure | one or more emergency stop devices | if: The following exceptions apply | [REG, Annex III, 1.2.4.3]
[30] manufacturer or the natural or legal person referred to in Article 18 | has obligation | shall apply one of the conformity assessment procedures | [REG, Art. 25(1)]
[31] manufacturers | has obligation | shall indicate their name | if: where that is not possible, on its packaging or in a document accompanying the machinery or related product | [REG, Art. 10(6)]

[34] machinery | must accompany | accompanied by instructions (instructions) | if: in the official Community language or languages of the Member State in which it is placed on the market and/or put into service | [DIR, Annex I, 1.7.4]
[35] manufacturers | has obligation | carry out sample testing | if: When deemed appropriate with regard to the risks presented by machinery or related products | [REG, Art. 10(4)]

[39] lifting accessories | must accompany | instructions setting out at least the following particulars | if: each lifting accessory or each commercially indivisible batch of lifting accessories | [REG, Annex III, 4.4.1]
[40] visual check of the machine and the protective device | requires periodic check | daily (P1D) | if: In many cases, it makes sense to carry out the following thorough checks daily | [nanoscan3-manual, p. 51]
[41] regular thorough check | maintenance rule | Carry out the checks specified in the test plan of the manufacturer… | [nanoscan3-manual, p. 114]
[42] manufacturer | has obligation | the limits of the safety functions are to be established as part… | if: where such modifications could lead to hazardous situations | [REG, Annex III, 1.2.1]
[43] manufacturers of partly completed machinery | has obligation | shall draw up the EU declaration of incorporation in accordance with Article… | if: Where compliance of partly completed machinery with the relevant essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III has been demonstrated in the… | [REG, Art. 11(2)]
[44] partly completed machinery | must accompany | EU declaration of incorporation set out in Annex V, Part B | if: or, alternatively, manufacturers shall provide the internet address or machine readable code | [REG, Art. 11(8)]
[45] manufacturer of machinery for plant protection products application | has obligation | shall ensure that an assessment is carried out | [REG, Annex III, 2.4.2]
[46] manufacturer | has obligation | perform appropriate tests, or have such tests performed | if: In order to verify that the relevant parts of the machinery or related product comply with the requirements set out in sections 2.4.5.1 and 2.4.5.2… | [REG, Annex III, 2.4.5.3]
[47] manufacturer of the machinery | has obligation | carry out a risk assessment | [nanoscan3-manual, p. 21]
[48] economic operators | has obligation | shall, on request, identify the following to the market surveillance authorities | if: on request | [REG, Art. 19(1)]
[49] authorised representative | defined as | means any natural or legal person established in the Community | if: who has received a written mandate from the manufacturer | [DIR, Art. 2]
[50] lifting accessory | defined as | means a component or equipment not attached to the lifting machinery | if: which is independently placed on the market | [DIR, Art. 2]
[51] putting into service | defined as | means the first use, for its intended purpose, in the Community | [DIR, Art. 2]
[52] safety component | defined as | means a component | if: which is independently placed on the market | [DIR, Art. 2]
[53] placing on the market | defined as | means making available for the first time in the Community | [DIR, Art. 2]
[54] harmonised standard | defined as | means a non-binding technical specification | [DIR, Art. 2]
[55] technical documentation | has obligation | shall include at least the following elements | [REG, Annex IV, Part A]
[56] manufacturers | has obligation | draw up the EU declaration of conformity in accordance with Article 21 | if: Where compliance of machinery or a related product with the essential health and safety requirements laid down in Annex III has been demonstrated by… | [REG, Art. 10(2)]
[57] manufacturers | has obligation | affix the CE marking in accordance with Article 24 | if: Where compliance of machinery or a related product with the essential health and safety requirements laid down in Annex III has been demonstrated by… | [REG, Art. 10(2)]
[58] manufacturer | has obligation | shall specify the means used by the manufacturer | [REG, Annex IV, Part A]
[59] references of harmonised standards applied | has obligation | the references of the harmonised standards | if: that have been applied for the design and manufacture of the machinery or related product | [REG, Annex IV, Part A]
[60] internal measures for series production | has obligation | the internal measures that will be implemented | if: for machinery or related products produced in series | [REG, Annex IV, Part A]

response.text: {"reasoning": "The question asks who is regarded as the manufacturer after a substantial modification, which is a 'who' question, so the answer is text. Fact 8 defines substantial modification as a modification not foreseen or planned by the manufacturer. Fact 7 (Regulation Art. 18) subjects the natural or legal person carrying out the substantial modification to the manufacturer's obligations, and fact 5 gives that person the obligation to ensure and declare on its sole responsibility. Fact 0 excludes a non-professional user modifying machinery for their own use. The date does not change the answer, because no date-dependent fact applies.", "kind": "text", "value": "The natural or legal person who carries out the substantial modification is treated as the manufacturer and is subject to the manufacturer's obligations under Regulation Art. 18, unless it is a non-professional user modifying machinery for its own use.", "text": "Under Regulation Article 18, the natural or legal person carrying out a substantial modification (an unforeseen modification by the manufacturer) is subject to the manufacturer's obligations, except a non-professional user modifying machinery for its own use.", "used": [0, 5, 7, 8]}
